commit.message:
QtQml: Make sure to mark generator stack frames properly

The interpreter doesn't use write barriers when writing the stack since
we expect the stack to be (re-)marked as needed by the GC. However,
generator functions execute on a special piece of stack they keep in an
object. That one a, needs extra marking during the regular stack marking
and b, needs a write barrier when we take the frame off the stack so
that any writes done to it before get marked.

Fixes: QTBUG-151273
